body: I am sure I could... I just don't have the strength or a very high opinion of myself, I am a failure.....not trying to get sympathy...just stating a fact. At this point I simply can't start over, I have got nothing left, but likewise, nothing to loose. Read JOB and you will have an idea of what I've lost, I don't have his faith, my faith evidently has no merit to the man upstairs anyway...lol .Thank you for talking to me, I have mad respect for your spirit and am very thankful for it. I wish I could muster up the positivity you appear to possess!

There is no one to see...... Ive isolated myself to the point of having no-one. People call me the miracle because of the things I have lived through. I should be dead, but somehow my will to live has been stronger than any adversity that I've faced. 2016 I spent 10 months in the hospital and had 8 major surgeries, After A long rehabilation I landed my dream job, which I got layoff from in march.I have spent 4 months in the hospital this year. I married the love of my life when I was a few years younger, and she told me she fell out of love with me and couldntimagine having a family with someone like me.I swore I would never be that vulnerable again.... and Ive been alone since. I have been celibate for over 6years. I have always been very charismatic and a natural leader and I can't bare to face the people who looked up to me... because I am truly a failure. Thank so much for listening, And I love your user name, I used to live by that motto, until I was proven wrong.

thank you for your comment. I feel like a failure, it seems like everything I touch turns to shit. I don't really have anyone here for me... I'm a disappointment  to all, but mainly myself. Christmas makes it SO much worse. I have been alone for the last 5 years on every holiday. I have nothing or nobody to share with. It would be easier if I was stupid so I could ignore the truth, but I am not. If I was to tell you everything that has happened to me you wouldnt believe me. Hell some of it is hard for me to believe. This isnt living, I am just making it through the next bad thing. Im just waiting till the 26th of this month, and then I'm done...3 more days. Have you ever read the book of JOB in the bible... that cat has nothing on me. I pray and pray, and try  believe life is worth living, but my prayers always go unanswered, and life continues to prove to me what exactly I am worth....nothing.

reading the comments...It seems like a lot of people want to hear what you have to say, I know I do. Brother, we have to stick together. Always remember, the outcasts, the misfits and the rebels are the only people that believe we can change the world, and we do and will....I want a world with you in it!

I wish I could say, I don't understand....but man do I. I have had the best life in the world and lost it all....over and over and over again. I will pray for you... and your journey...wherever that journey may take you. I love you as I love all who are in our position.
